rules: Internal commits and cheap/unit gates are allowed; user-facing micro-beta installation chains remain forbidden.
Work is organized as large coherent functional waves; one full Android/rendered qualification is preferred per consolidated head unless a real failure requires repair.
No fixed 25-minute engineering tranche exists; START→work→END is milestone-based and ends at a coherent result, real human/security gate, or explicit stop.
Strong Stabilizer remains a required advanced A+B+C value block but stays gated until benefit, safety, resource and rollback evidence exist.
Macro maturity changes only when evidence supports a real stage transition.

waves.name: Truth + proof foundation
waves.exit_gate: fresh exact-head 45-shot proof + manual semantic audit

waves.name: Platform diagnostics + capability discovery
deliverables: Data Saver / Usage Access / Android 17 LAN permission awareness
waves.exit_gate: unit/instrumentation tests + no extra permission prompt + technical diagnostics proof

waves.name: Context + Mobile Vault core
deliverables: trusted/home Wi-Fi memory with privacy-preserving identity
waves.exit_gate: local-only persistence + migration + privacy + zero-paid-probe gates
proven_now: Mobile Vault economic envelopes and durable local plan/cycle/expiry store
optional bounded NetworkStats lane with Usage Access fail-open
dedicated Mobile Vault surface and offline fallback
waves.next_block: Carrier/operator adapters and authoritative per-SIM truth are deferred; they do not block the usable 0.8 field candidate.

waves.name: Complete product surfaces + diagnostics
waves.exit_gate: large-font/target-device visual matrix + export privacy allowlist + offline usability
proven_now: This Week local 7-day report and sharing
60-shot responsive matrix plus manual visual counter-audit
waves.next_block: Target-phone field validation, then richer diagnostic ZIP/energy/crash/failure-cluster depth.

waves.name: Strong Stabilizer SHADOW / per-app canary
waves.exit_gate: fuzzing + IPv4/IPv6/QUIC + handoff + battery/RAM + rollback + no-harm evidence

waves.name: Network Twin replay + SHADOW learner
waves.exit_gate: replay determinism + stale-evidence invalidation + no automatic promotion without proof

waves.name: One coherent field candidate
deliverables: single signed update over installed baseline
waves.exit_gate: field evidence complete; only then canonical promotion
proven_now: single INSTALL_NOW path updated in place
waves.next_block: Human installs 0.8 over 0.7.3; run focused target-device field/resource validation. W4/W5 remain advanced future scope.
